title: Vice President at Rescale Sees CoreWeave Facing Pricing Pressure and Refinancing Risks
expert: Former VP of Sales, Americas at Rescale (HPC orchestration partner of CoreWeave, ~2 years)
verdict: A former Rescale sales VP saw CoreWeave lose almost 100% of the large enterprise GPU deals he worked to the hyperscalers, as its historical 10%-30% discount turned into parity or a premium after a 25% price increase, while reservation lead times stretched to 10-12 months.

GPU pricing: Almost 100% of large enterprise opportunities went to cloud providers after CoreWeave moved from 10%-30% cheaper to parity/premium; conflicts with 2026-11-05 call (gaining share, reseller +17.5%-20%). Inflection. Tenet 6 down
Contracted power → active power conversi: Reservation lead times 10-12 months vs a week or two (first-hand); consistent with SB #66250. Tenet 1 up
Cost of debt: Refinancing $2.3B facility due March 2028 at 13%-15% very risky vs 7% or below (estimate). Tenet 5 down

changes: Share vs hyperscalers: almost 100% of large enterprise deals lost to cloud providers vs the 2026-11-05 expert call (IT reseller) seeing CoreWeave gaining share and reseller business +17.5%-20% y/y: conflicting 🔺 Inflection.

Pricing: 25% hike across the SKU lineup (hearsay) vs mgmt's 20%+ increases on older chip models at Citi TMT (SB #67233, 2026-11-03): consistent (prices up), but the expert says it cost large-deal wins.

Margins: expert sees gross margin about 65% falling to 55% and EBITDA about 59% to the 50% range (estimate) vs Deutsche Bank's contribution margins on 2Q deals 5-10pts above prior (SB #67240, 2026-11-04): conflicting.
Lead times: reservations 10-12 months vs a week or two (expert's own comparison); SemiAnalysis sees CoreWeave mostly sold out for 2027 (SB #66250, 2026-11-05): consistent.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (backlog conversion): ↑ — reservation lead times 10-12 months vs a week or two; >$100B backlog as anchor (hearsay).
Tenet 4 (pricing inflecting): → — the 25% hike stuck, but at parity/premium to hyperscalers CoreWeave lost almost 100% of large enterprise deals the expert saw.
Tenet 5 (financing moat): ↓ — refinancing the $2.3B March 2028 facility at 13%-15% would be dangerous vs ≤7% manageable.
Tenet 6 (supply wave / competition): ↓ — hyperscalers winning large enterprise deals, Nebius undercutting, frontier labs reselling excess capacity; enterprise GPU usage -25%-40% (estimate).
